changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1. RAM-R1 records a mono take from the master mix or inputs; RAM-P1 plays it with sample controls.
RAM-P1 now plays a take at its recorded level; 1.1.1 played takes about 17 dB quieter. Existing projects will play RAM-P1 louder.
Takes are normalized when recording ends, so BR (bit reduction) on RAM-P1 sounds as it does on a normal sample. RAM-P1 always plays the newest take.
Known issue: a trig with STRT inside a long take, in the second after recording ends, can briefly play quieter.
Now listed as incompatible with Digi Health, which changes the same firmware code. The builder already refused this pair.
